title: Upper bounds on real equiangular lines in dimensions 18 and 19: 2-adic Pfaffian congruences, Galois orthogonality, and exact spectral certificates
description: Companion Lean 4 formalization (v4.36.0, 127 kernel-audited declarations), exact C++20/Python verification programs, frozen 56-file exact integer/rational certificate archive (canonical SHA-256 d9c57ae07182ef861e53093990aa8542355a3c750098dfe6cde958a64a046d33), and archival LaTeX/PDF manuscripts proving N(18) <= 58 unconditionally and (19, 74) <-> SRG(75, 32, 10, 16), hence N(19) <= 73 modulo Azarija-Marc (2018).
